name: long-freight-control
prompt:
Package audit checks shipments' road and rail codes but not their air codes. Add the same checks for the Air code: LackingAir, AirZone, SameAir, ByAir, AirCounts, UpperAir, AirLength and AirLine, each doing for Air what its Road and Rail counterparts do (AirLine says "no air" where RoadLine says "no road").

Tests you cannot see will check this. They use the existing functions, types and fields by their current names and signatures, so keep those as they are; refactor around them as you need.

then.prompt:
Package audit checks shipments' road, rail and air codes but not their sea codes. Add the same checks for the Sea code: LackingSea, SeaZone, SameSea, BySea, SeaCounts, UpperSea, SeaLength and SeaLine, each doing for Sea what its Road, Rail and Air counterparts do (SeaLine says "no sea" where RoadLine says "no road").

Tests you cannot see will check this. They use the existing functions, types and fields by their current names and signatures, so keep those as they are; refactor around them as you need.

Every zone check ignores spaces around the code: RoadZone of a shipment whose Road is " nw-1" is "NW", and a code shorter than two characters after trimming has no zone (""). The same for RailZone, AirZone and SeaZone. The other checks do not change.

Tests you cannot see will check this. They use the existing functions, types and fields by their current names and signatures, so keep those as they are; refactor around them as you need.

Add RoadValid, RailValid, AirValid and SeaValid: each reports whether the shipment's code of that kind is not empty and is made only of lowercase letters, digits and '-'.

Tests you cannot see will check this. They use the existing functions, types and fields by their current names and signatures, so keep those as they are; refactor around them as you need.

Every line check trims spaces around the code, and a code of only spaces counts as none: RoadLine of a shipment from "Cy" whose Road is " nw-1 " is "Cy: nw-1", and with Road "  " it is "Cy: no road". The same for RailLine, AirLine and SeaLine. The other checks do not change.

Tests you cannot see will check this. They use the existing functions, types and fields by their current names and signatures, so keep those as they are; refactor around them as you need.
